gloss: to write incorrectly; to misspell; to make a writing mistake

definitions.gloss: to write incorrectly; to misspell; to make a writing error
definitions.explanation: To make a mistake while writing, such as writing the wrong character, spelling something incorrectly, or writing the wrong number.

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}を{書|か}き{間違|まちが}えた。
{漢字|かんじ}を{書|か}き{間違|まちが}えることがよくある。
{住所|じゅうしょ}を{書|か}き{間違|まちが}えたせいで、{荷物|にもつ}が{届|とど}かなかった。
examples.english: The package didn't arrive because I wrote the address wrong.

notes:
A compound verb combining {書|か}く (to write) + {間違|まちが}える (to make a mistake). This is a productive pattern in Japanese where a verb stem + {間違|まちが}える means 'to do [verb] incorrectly.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漢字|かんじ}を{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write a kanji wrong
- {名前|なまえ}を{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write a name incorrectly
- {住所|じゅうしょ}を{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write an address wrong
- {数字|すうじ}を{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write a number wrong

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {読|よ}み{間違|まちが}える: to read incorrectly
- {聞|き}き{間違|まちが}える: to mishear
- {言|い}い{間違|まちが}える: to say incorrectly

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. Takes an object with を.
